evidence.sourceTitle: Linear raises USD 35M Series B led by Accel
evidence.shortExcerpt: Linear announced a USD 35m Series B led by Accel with Sequoia and 01 Advisors participating.

observedFacts.statement: Linear announced a USD 35 million Series B on 2023-09-14.
Linear said Sequoia, 01 Advisors and individual software operators participated in the Series B.
Linear said it had been growing and operating profitably since 2021.
Linear said it was a team of 50 people on 2023-09-14.
Linear said it was trusted and used by thousands of companies of all sizes.
Linear said the Series B was led by Accel.
